resources.string: Readings are arriving and the watch has the latest one.
This app reads the value from the LinX notification, so it needs permission to see notifications. It ignores everything that is not from LinX.
Permission is granted. Open LinX so it refreshes its notification; this usually takes under a minute.
Nothing has arrived recently. Check that LinX is running and still connected to the sensor.
Readings are arriving, but the watch is out of range or switched off. It will catch up on its own once it reconnects.

Readings are arriving, but no watch is running a compatible copy of CGM Glance, so none of this is reaching your wrist. Install the watch APK — and make sure both it and the phone app came from the same build. Two apps signed with different keys never pair, and the system reports no error when they don\'t.
The LinX layout changed, so values are being found by position rather than by name. Still working, but it needs a look before the fallback stops matching too.
Shows a value the official app has already computed. Not a medical device: never use it for treatment decisions, and always confirm with the official app or a meter.
Used for colour and wording only. This app never alerts on these values — alarms stay with the official app.
Urgent low must be below low, and low below high. All three must be values a sensor can report.
Tells you when CGM Glance has stopped receiving readings.
CGM Glance cannot read glucose without it. Tap to fix.
Nothing has arrived for a while. Check that LinX is running and connected to the sensor.
Off. Turn it on under “Target range and unit” to write readings to Health Connect.
Writing one reading every %1$d minutes to Health Connect. Samsung Health reads them from there, if you have enabled that link in its settings.
Set up. The next reading due will be written, then one every %1$d minutes.
Allow CGM Glance to write glucose to Health Connect. Samsung Health then reads it from there.
Health Connect is not available on this phone. Install it, then turn on the Health Connect link inside Samsung Health.
Health Connect needs updating before it can accept readings.
The last write failed. Readings are still reaching the watch.
Writes your readings to Health Connect, which Samsung Health reads from. Nothing is ever read back.
Between %1$d and %2$d minutes. The default is 15.
The interval must be between %1$d and %2$d minutes.
